description: Fleet-shape response check for COVID-COOP-V1: coarse generic-voyage cells at the parent design's three takeoff-lattice Thetas under the same sixteen arms (beta-Poisson baseline + n* {2,3,5} x carrier_loading {four corners + interior}). The cooperative arm shrinks the airborne infectious dose while leaving PCR-visible load intact, so the fleet-shape medians are expected to sag below their paired baseline rows -- this design measures the direction and magnitude class of that shift at 50 seeds per row. It is NOT a re-admission: 50-seed medians at the lattice points answer 'did the admissible band move under the law' and point a follow-on re-screen where to look; they carry no selector verdict and no Theta is admitted from this surface.
prerequisites: covid_coop_v1 (parent): the clause-response conditioned replay assay this fleet check accompanies -- same arms, same image, same campaign submission.

THETA-SCREEN-V13 measured (edb7fc41): the admissible band {1.78e11..5.62e11} the lattice straddles; the parent lattice {1e11, 2.37e11, 1e12} sits below, inside, and above it so the fleet read shows the arm's band-shift direction at both edges.

COVID-PACKET-01 / COVID-COOP-02 measured: the arm's far-field inertness at n* >= 3 and partial n* = 2 suppression are the mechanism the fleet distribution is expected to express as lowered attack-rate quantiles per arm.
voyage_mode_note: Generic voyages verbatim from covid_theta_screen_v13 stage 1 / covid_ring_cap_v1_fleet: the explicit seed's onset_day/departure_day are dropped, its infection age is drawn from the profile's incubation distribution, 168 epochs, no interventions, the scenario's molecular_ascertainment_start_day dropped (a DP particular) so the modality's default swab channel stays open from embarkation. Carried: imports 1, dwell_weighted sanitary visits.
thetas_note: The parent's three lattice points verbatim, anchor first -- no boundary or anchor rows: the question is how the band's neighbourhood moves under each arm, not where a new band's edges sit.
infection_age_note: Placeholder required by the cell enumeration grammar, verbatim from v13/ring_cap_fleet: under generic mode the import's age is drawn per voyage and age0d carries no meaning.
seeds_note: First 50 of the v13 stage-1 seed block (base 20201001) verbatim, matching every prior fleet companion -- every fleet cell pairs seed-for-seed with the v13 stage-1 cells at the nearest Theta -- coarse (50-seed) read by declaration; a band re-screen under the arm is a separate design if the parent's verdict calls for one.

arms.note: v13 baseline arm -- seed-for-seed pairing against the v13 stage-1 rows.
n*2 x dry-high/wet-low -- the partially-live far-field corner at n*2.

cells_note: 3 Thetas x 16 arms x 50 seeds = 2,400 generic cells (~7 min each). Cell order point x arm x seed, anchor point first: indices 0-799 = Theta 2.37e11 x 16 arms x 50 seeds; 800-1599 = Theta 1e11; 1600-2399 = Theta 1e12.

admissibility.note: FROZEN: the fleet_shape_selector numbers are quoted verbatim for reporting only -- no row on this design is admitted or rejected. The readout reports median attack rate, IQR, takeoff fraction, P(attack >= 0.10) per (theta, arm) beside the paired baseline row, and the paired per-seed deltas between arms.
admissibility.fleet_shape_selector_report_only: median recorded attack rate in [0.0005, 0.008], IQR overlapping [0.0003, 0.015], mean <= 0.06 -- reported as in/out per row arm, never as a selection verdict: the coarse seed count does not re-admit anything.

execution.platform: AWS Batch EC2 Spot via deploy/aws/submit_covid_boarding_screen.sh with DESIGN=covid_coop_v1_fleet, on the same image as the parent design.
execution.canary: First Theta block's baseline row plus the n2_lolo row: INDEX_OFFSET 0, ARRAY_SIZE 100 covers beta_poisson (0-49) and n2_lolo (50-99) at Theta 2.37e11 -- dose_response-echo proof the coop override lands under generic mode plus contract integrity. Remaining rows proceed on a clean read per the campaign gate.
execution.report_immediately_if: an arm row's median lands more than one lattice notch from its baseline comparator in EITHER direction (mechanism moves the band more than expected); a coop cell's dose_response echo lacks the arm's declared params (the arm did not reach the engine); or child failure rate exceeds 5%.
